content: Dadda piig maraw ard agɛɛragɛɛra tuughwahaana
“Bak jiir wan tagkurtag Farisiyaha, baɗǝm dadakwa dagha bi damma agɛɛragɛɛra dǝ ghaiy gud biya, bakǝvakwaha kaa tlǝlla ɗulla dass kǝ-iin tǝ kwatlǝrǝn kǝ ghyǝba, gǝlla dlaɓa gwarǝɗ nǝ-iina.
“Dadakwa dǝgaa dǝ ghaiya wakyagha, iin dadda piiya tuughwaha.
Dadda uufa ghaiya wakyagha wurgarwurǝgga kǝ-iina. Tuughwah dlaɓa ar cingarnucinga kǝ kungya dada piiga. Ɗahǝtǝrɗaga kǝ tuughwahaan dǝ ɗagahaatǝra, ngal langtǝrlang dagal da gyǝmǝlla.
Tǝhala kwama dadal kǝ tuughwahaan baɗǝm da gyǝmǝlla, kaa dal kǝ-iin tǝvukwatǝra, tuughahah dlaɓa ar gatǝgaan tǝhaltǝhala, aɗaba ar sǝrǝgasǝrǝg kǝ ghaiyaana.
Ar tapǝnaiy kǝ gata ghullab badǝm biya, ba kǝ jiirra ar hǝdla dagal vakaana, aɗaba ar dzǝgaakaiy kǝ ghaiya ghullab biya.”
Tagatǝrdatag nǝ Yesu kǝ uudaha kǝ kwanǝn kǝ ǝlbǝg dǝghura, bakǝvakwaha nǝghǝnǝgharaakai kǝ dǝgit tagtǝr nǝ-iin biya.
Aɗabadkwaha am Yesu kǝ-iitǝr gwiiyadalla, “Bak jiijiira, ǝn tagkurtaga, kaiy nǝ ghaiya gudlǝgha tuughwaha.
Baɗǝm lii sarǝva lakwti ǝn sagau naiya ar gǝllaha dlaɓa ar gwarǝɗɗaha, tuughwahahin ndakwi ar cingtǝrnu biya.
Kaiy nǝ ghaiya wakyagha, baɗǝm dadakwa dǝga tǝdǝvad kaiya da katava. Ar da saasa dlaɓa ar da dagala, ar da tlǝkǝnatlǝg vaka piig marawa.
Gǝla sagau kwakyarvad ɓa gǝl kaltiya ard tsa shifǝga dlaɓa ard ghyǝhǝga, kaiya sanǝv taakiya ar tlǝkǝna kǝ shifǝga, dlaɓa ar tlǝkǝnan bajar righǝrighaana.
“Kaiy nǝ dadda piig marawa. Dadda piig marawa iin wa vǝlla shifǝgaan kwakyarvad tuughwaha.

Suuniya iin bi nǝ dadda piig biya, dlaɓa tuughwaha dǝgaan biya. Aɗabadkwaha bamma sarti ma nǝghǝghanǝghǝg kǝ ghǝygya tǝghal sagauwa, kaa ɗuwaras kǝ-iin kǝ tuughwaha ngal hǝdla dagalaana. Ghǝgya tǝghal da dǝtraadǝg kǝ giɗya tuughwaha dlaɓa kwazǝtǝrdana.
Əmdǝradagala nǝ uuddanǝn aɗaba suuniya nǝ-iina ɓa tlǝra kwaɓa, maay lamban dǝ tuughwaha biya.
“Kaiy nǝ dadda piiga marawa. Ən sǝrǝgasǝrǝg kǝ tuughwahara, tuughwahara ar sǝrkwasǝrǝga.
Bandkwan sǝrkwa nǝ Daada, kai dlaɓ ǝn sǝrgasǝrǝga kǝ iina. Dlaɓa ǝn vǝlgaan kǝ shiifǝgara kwakyarvad tuughwahaha.

Ən mǝng nai dǝ kyǝlǝma tuughwaha kwar dǝga kwanǝn kǝ agɛɛragɛɛra biya. Iitǝr ndakwi barari ǝn sǝtǝrddana. Ghǝravaatǝr ndakwi ar da ciingaan kǝ kungyara, ar da nal kǝ agɛɛragɛɛra palla, dadda piig palla.
“Kwakyarvad kwah wa waikwa Daddara, aɗaba ǝn vǝldavǝlǝg kǝ shifǝgara, dlaɓa ǝn gwiidagwiiga.
Maay nǝ dadakwa kǝsǝgwavakǝsǝg kǝ shifǝg biya, aɗaba kaiy wan vǝlǝgaan dǝ naaga ghǝrara. Ən dǝ ndzǝɗa vǝldavǝlga, ǝn ndzǝɗa gwiidagwiga sǝddan dlaɓa. Kwan kǝ dǝgit wa taghwa nǝ Daddara kǝ ɓagaana.”
Kwakyarvad kwan kǝ ǝlbǝggǝn tagada nǝ Yesu, gwiya sadasǝg kǝ taagwavǝgh mataataka Yahudaha.
Baɗyak ma iitǝra, ar taakiya, “Shatanaha wa ma vǝghaana, iin wa ɓag nǝ-iin kǝ valaagǝrna. Aaujilǝbǝg am ciingarnuciingi?”
Bakǝvakwaha am kyǝlǝmaha, “Kwanahaan kǝ ǝlbǝga tagdai nǝ daddakwad shiɗǝkwa ghwaɗ mavǝghaan biya. Kats wurǝgarantwurǝg shiɗǝkwa ghwaɗ kǝ gyi kǝ gulǝfa?”
Fardǝghǝrǝt bi nǝ yaa Yahuda tǝ Yesu biya
Masarta kwaha ndza akwhya vakka, ɓa hwaɗaga dzama hyaɗa vǝgya Dadamazhigǝl nǝ-uud ma wurushalima.
Yesu ndza gwayav ma gagaazaya Sulemanu ma vǝgya Dadamazhǝgǝla.
Kaa dzahvǝtdzahǝg kǝ Yahudaha tǝghǝr kǝ-iina, kaa ndavgarundavǝg kǝ iitǝr taakiya, “Agha ɗukǝmǝndars ndar ma dzamaghǝr tǝghǝr kǝskǝgh mbǝrdakwani? Maba kǝgh nǝ Kǝristi tagkǝmǝndtag bat ɓalaɓala.”
Ngwatǝrangug nǝ Yesu kǝ iitǝra, “Tagankurdatag bawura, famdǝghǝrǝt biya. Tlǝrahaan ǝn ɓag naay ma ɗaaga Daadarna, iitǝr shidahara.
Kurama famdǝghǝrǝt biya, aɗaba am tuughwahar bi nǝ-uuram biya.
Tuughwahara ar cinngacinng kǝ ǝlbǝgara ǝn sǝrǝtǝrsǝrǝga, dlaɓa ar gatkwagatǝga.
Ən vǝltǝr shifǝga tangw damma zǝrazǝra, ar da tapǝnay kǝ ǝmǝtsǝg biya, maay dlaɓa wa da hutsǝrvahutsǝg sagal miizha dǝvvar biya.
Daadara, kwa vǝlǝghwavǝlǝg kǝ tughwahaana jujig dǝ ndzǝd baɗǝma, maay wa da hutsǝtǝrdahutsǝg sagal miizha dǝva Daadar biya
Kaiya ard Daada kǝmba palla.”
Kaa gwiya cagantcag kǝ yaa Yahuda kǝ akurah kiyavva ɗawalǝgaana.
Aiyam Yesu taa kǝ-iitǝra, ɓagankuraɓag kǝ tlǝrah maraw baɗyak vak Daada, am da ɗawalkwa kwakyarvad kwar kaci nǝ-uurami?”
Aiyam yaa Yahuda, kǝm ɗawalǝk kwakyarvad tlǝr marawǝn ɓagha nǝng biya, kwakyarvad badza ɗaaga Daadamazhigǝla. Kǝgha agha uud ba gyaagyaana a gǝra ghǝragh dǝ Dadamazhǝgǝla.
Aiyam Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Vindavai kwan ma adzahadzhaharu taakiya, ‘Amaiya am ghǝlaha biya’?
Am sǝrǝgasǝrǝg taakiya, ǝlbǝga Dadamazhǝgǝl vindavindana ndzǝga bat jiir ba kǝlaa hǝnga. Akwama ɗahavtǝr dǝ ‘Ghǝlaha’ nǝ lii cauwara ǝlbǝga Yaazhigǝla,

aujilbǝgci kǝskuram am taakiya ǝn badza ɗaaga Daadamazhigǝl mbakyarvad naa tagda taakiya Kaiy nǝ zǝra Daadamazhigǝli? Maay ba wah ndakwi kai wa fakwi nǝ Dadda ba kǝrkangyakwa, dlaɓa ɓǝlakwadiɓǝllǝg sama duniya.
Akwama tlǝra Daadar bi wan ɓag nai biya, famdǝghǝrǝt bi tǝ kaiy biya.
Akwama iitǝr wan ɓag naiya, aanji famdǝghǝrǝt bi tǝ kaiy biya, famdǝghǝrǝtfǝg tǝ tlǝrahara, aɗaba am sǝrana, dlaɓa am nǝghǝghaaka taakiya, Daada ma kaiya, kaiy dlaɓa ma iina.”
Kaa gwiya ɓaa kǝla ndzǝɗatǝr kǝ viigaana, bakǝvakwaha ngǝdlatǝrvangǝdlǝg nǝ Yesu ma dǝvvatǝra.
Tǝhala kwaha kaa gwig kǝ Yesu damma hal dzǝva kǝ zaagha Urudun, da vavaki ɓaga nǝ Yuhwana kǝ tsuufǝg ba zǝngwa, ndza kǝ-iin vakwaha.
Uudaha baɗyaka sarǝvǝsǝg sa vakaana, kaa ba tagaan kǝ-iitǝr taakiya, “Tapǝghanaiy nǝ Yuhwana kǝ ɓa dǝga japǝr biya, bakǝvakwaha baɗǝm nǝ dǝgiti taga nǝ-iin tǝghǝr kǝ uudanǝna ba jirra.”
Lii ndzar vakwah dlaɓa baɗyaka fardǝghǝrǝtfǝg tǝ Yesu.
